prd_facts.fact: The free-shipping threshold applies to the merchandise after discounts and after the loyalty discount.
Loyalty points are redeemed before shipping is quoted: price and discounts, then redemption, then shipping, then tax.
The loyalty discount reduces the amount to pay but not the tax base.
Thresholds are unchanged: 200.00 standard and 100.00 VIP, reached when merchandise is equal or above.
The shipping, checkout and loyalty rules are consistent with each other and cross-reference each other.
Redemption limits (multiples of 100, at least 500, up to 50% of merchandise after discounts) and express and free-shipping-coupon behavior do not change.
